Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a compact ask-list so we can qualify next steps and timeline for a Dedicated/private deployment: 

What we covered (high level):
- Your primary concern: incident notification timelines and cross-border data controls for clinical datasets.
- Compliance posture: SOC 2 in progress, exploring HIPAA scope for a subset of workloads, GDPR review for EU data.
- Operational ask: ability to provide BCP/DR artifacts and incident response evidence for vendor review.

Action items for Sentinel SG (can be delivered via the secure share or as attachments):
1) SOC 2 status + any interim evidence you can share (report in progress, scope, target Type/Date).
2) Confirmation of HIPAA scope and whether you can sign a BAA; if yes, can you share the draft or a DocuSign link.
3) Incident response timeline commitment (how quickly you notify customers for different severities) and any runbooks/drill summaries.
4) BCP/DR artifacts: DR runbook summary, last tabletop/test date, RTO/RPO targets.

I attached a short onboarding checklist (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf) to make it easy — feel free to drop the files in the secure folder below or reply with attachments.

Secure folder (preferred): https://secure-drive.example.com/sentinel-sg/onboarding/

Suggested next step: 30-min follow-up next week to review artifacts and finalize the mutual action plan (we'll include Rishi and our legal contact if needed).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on these.

Best,

Hi Mina / Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the checklist — that helps. High-level responses and what we can provide this week: 

1) SOC 2: We are currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II readiness checks. Full Type II target date is Q2 2027; we can share the most recent internal controls summary and the external auditor engagement letter. Attached: sentinel-sg-soc-progress.pdf (partial evidence).

2) HIPAA / BAA: We do operate on clinical datasets under contract. Procurement prefers DocuSign for BAAs — I can send a template link. If legal needs edits, we'll coordinate.

3) Incident notifications: Our current internal commitment is: P0 (data exposure impacting PHI) — initial alert within 1 hour, P1 (service degradation with potential data impact) — initial alert within 4 hours; full incident report within 72 hours. I will confirm internal SLAs and provide a short runbook excerpt.

4) BCP/DR: I'll upload a short DR-runbook-summary.docx and a tabletop-test summary from June 2026. RTO targets vary by product (generally 4–8 hours for critical services).

I'll place the documents in the secure folder you provided and share the DocuSign BAA link once procurement triggers it.

One clarification: when you say "evidence" for SOC 2, do you need auditor reports or control artifacts (logs/config snapshots)? We can provide both but may need to redact some internal hostnames.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Information Security | Sentinel SG
aisha.khan@sentinel-sg.com
